title: AFRICA HOCKEY 5's YOUTH TOURNAMENT.
excerpt: Kenya's U18 boys went unbeaten to win the inaugural Hockey5s Youth Africa Cup, beating South Africa 6-5 in the final — and both Kenyan teams qualified for the FIH Youth Hockey5s World Cup in December.

title: What Kenya's Historic Hosting Of The Youth Africa Cup Means
excerpt: Kenya didn't just host the first-ever Hockey5s Youth Africa Cup — it won it. We look at what that means for the sport's pipeline, and how it connects to our own 29 August event on Kenya hockey's future.
